sharedRules.name: Let the Galaxy Burn
sharedRules.description:
Chaos Space Marine unit with this rule gain +1 to the charge roll in the Charge Phase against a Charge Target for each of the following conditions met (to a max of +4. This is not cumulative with bonuses from the Sprint (x) special rule):
• The Charge Target is Pinned.
• The Charge Target is affected by Blind.
• The Charge Target is affected by Concussive.
• The Charge Target is Falling Back after failing a Panic test.
• The Charge Target has a lower Leadership (LD) characteristic than the charging Chaos Space Marine unit.
• The Charging Chaos Space Marine unit has more models in their unit than the Charge Target. (Bulky (x) units count as X number of models each for determining this bonus).

rules.name: Chaos Sigil
rules.description: A model with a Chaos Sigil has a 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Daemonic Steed
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Daemonic Steed becomes a Cavalry type unit. In addition, it gains +1 Strength (S), Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) Characteristics.

rules.name: Aura of Dark Glory
rules.description: A model with a Aura of Dark Glory has a 5+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Chaos Familiar
rules.description: A model with Chaos Familiar gains +1 to their Attacks (A) characteristic.

rules.name: Daemon Engine Armour
rules.description: The living armoured skin of the Dameon engines crafted by Chaos artifice. It confers a 3+ armour save.

rules.name: The Mark of Chaos Undivided
rules.description:
• A unit with this Mark gains the Undivided Keyword and may only be joined by units with the Undivided, Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle or Slaanesh keywords.
• A unit with this Mark gains the Fear (1) special rule. If the unit already has the Fear (x) special rule, increase the value of X by 1.
• In addition, if the unit would fail a Panic test, instead of Falling Back, the unit takes D3 wounds with no saves or mitigation rolls allowed.
• A unit with this wargear gains access to the Lore of Slaanesh, Nurgle and Tzeentch Psychic Powers if they have the Psyker (x) special rule.

rules.name: The Mark of Khorne
rules.description:
• A unit with this Mark gains the Khorne Keyword and may only join or be joined by units with the Khorne or Undivided Keywords.
• A unit with this mark gains the Furious Charge special rule. If the unit already has the Furious Charge special rule it gains +1 to its Attack (A) characteristic.
• A unit with the Psyker (x) special rule may not purchase this wargear.

rules.name: The Mark of Nurgle
rules.description:
• A unit with this Mark gains the Nurgle Keyword and may only join or be joined by units with the Nurgle or Undivided Keywords.
• A unit with this mark gains the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule. If the unit does not have a Wounds (W) characteristic, it instead always gains the Benefits of Heavy Cover.
• A unit with this wargear gains access to the Lore of Nurgle Psychic Powers if they have the Psyker (x) special rule.

rules.name: The Mark of Slaanesh
rules.description:
• A unit with this Mark gains the Slaanesh Keyword and may only join or be joined by units with the Slaanesh or Undivided Keywords.
• A unit with this mark gains +1 to their Initiative (I) characteristic.
• A unit with this Mark gains the Sudden Strike special rule.
• A unit with this wargear gains access to the Lore of Slaanesh Psychic Powers if they have the Psyker (x) special rule.

rules.name: The Mark of Tzeentch
rules.description:
• A unit with this Mark gains the Tzeentch Keyword and may only join or be joined by units with the Tzeentch or Undivided Keywords.
• A unit with this mark gains +1 to their Invulnerable saves (to a max of 3+). If they do not have an Invulnerable save, they gain a 6+ Invulnerable save.
• In addition, A unit with this wargear and the Psyker (x) special rule may re-roll 1 dice when making a Psychic Test.
• A unit with this wargear gains access to the Tzeentch Psychic Powers if they have the Psyker (x) special rule.

rules.name: Wings
rules.description: A model with this wargear increases their Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. It gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep strike special rules.

rules.name: Chaos Runes
rules.description: A model with a Chaos Runes has a 6+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Icon of Chaos
rules.description: A unit that includes a model equipped with the Icon of Chaos always counts as scoring 1 additional Wound for the purposes of Combat resolution. Additionally, a unit that arrives on the battlefield via Deep Strike within 12” of a unit with this wargear does not scatter. Finally, when a unit which includes a model with this special rule would conduct a Fall Back Move which would cause it to move off the table, the unit instead stops 1” away from the table edge and automatically rallies in your next Movement Phase.

rules.name: Warp Armour
rules.description: Daemonic infused Armour issued to veterans and champions. It provides a 2+ Armour Save.

rules.name: Blades of Putrefaction (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Poison (4+) special rule on all Melee weapons they are equipped with until the start of your next Shooting Phase. If an effected model is equipped with a Melee type weapon with the Poison (x) special rule, it becomes Poison (2+) instead.

rules.name: Nurgles Rot (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 12” of the Psyker. The target unit takes 2D6, Strength 2, AP-, automatic hits.

rules.name: Fleshy Abundance (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker or 1 friendly model within 24” Heals 1 lost Wound.

rules.name: Curse of the Leper (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker. The target unit suffers -1 to its Strength (S) & Toughness (T) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Hysterical Frenzy (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Arcing (6+) special rule on all melee weapons they are equipped with until the start of your next Shooting Phase. If the unit already has Arcing (x), improve Arcing (x) by 1 to a max of 3+.

rules.name: Delightful Agonies (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Symphony of Pain (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker. The target unit suffers -1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) and Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Boon of Change (Psychic Power)
rules.description:
When this power is cast, the Psyker and their attached unit must pick to gain one of the following until the start of your next Shooting Phase:
• +1 to its Attack (A) characteristic
• +1 to its Strength (S) characteristic.
• +1 to its Initiative (I) characteristic
This power may be cast any number of times by a Psyker in the Shooting Phase if they can cast multiple times.

rules.name: Siphon Magic (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit with the Psyker (x) special rule within 18” of the Psyker. The target unit may not cast any make any Psychic tests to cast Psychic Powers or Psychic Weapons until the start of your next Shooting Phase. In addition, if the target unit has any Psychic Powers or Psychic Weapons in effect, including Force, that effect is negated.

rules.name: Treason of Tzeentch (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this Power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 24” of the Psyker that is not an Automata or Drone Type. Immediately make a single Shooting Attack with the targeted unit as if it were your own. The unit is treated as your own for the purposes of determining friendly and enemy targets. The Shooting Attack by the controlled target unit are resolved as Snap Shots. The target unit is treated as an enemy unit immediately after its Shooting Attack is resolved.

selectionEntries.name: Baleful Devolution (Psychic Power)
selectionEntries.comment: todo: No Chaos Spawn profile in reference

rules.name: Baleful Devolution (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker. The target unit takes 2D6, Strength 4, AP4 Automatic Hits. If any models are slain in the target unit as a result of wounds inflicted by this Psychic Power, immediately summon a Chaos Spawn more than 3” away from the targeted enemy unit.

rules.name: Rite of Iron Boons
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Vehicle, Aircraft, Automata, or Knight unit within 3” of the unit performing this Rite. The target unit gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS) until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Rite of Corruption
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 enemy Vehicle, Aircraft, Automata, Drone, Battlesuit or Knight unit within 24” of the unit performing this Rite. Select 1 weapon that unit is equipped with. It may only make Snap Shots with that weapon until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Rite of Scrap Code
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 enemy Vehicle, Aircraft, Automata, Drone, Battlesuit or Knight unit within 12” of the unit performing this Rite. That target unit takes D6, Strength 1, AP-, Haywire (5+) Automatic Hits.

rules.name: Benediction of Darkness
rules.description: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the benefits of Light Cover until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Plea of Restoration
rules.description: If this Prayer is answered, the Priest Heals 1 wound. If the Priest has no allocated wounds, you may heal 1 wound on an attached unit. If the attached unit has no allocated wounds but has slain models, you may return 1 model back to the unit with 1 wound remaining.

rules.name: Litany of Despair
rules.description: When this Prayer is performed, all enemy units within 3” of the Priest and any attached unit suffer -1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.
